activity_summary: Before the rehearsal you looked at the plot on the nail, at a blank margin in the book, and at the watchet gown on a hook. Nothing was ticked. The gown was not yet worn. Fifty shillings was still not written as paid.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the plot and the blank margin, and did not take the gown down.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Was at the stool with the book, and is not heard in this look.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in The plot on the nail

facets.activity: Looked at the plot before anyone spoke
